subject: A ninth source family for the Warmly MCP
body:
Warmly fixes its ingest surface at eight source families and normalises every signal into one shape. Newsletter coverage is not one of them, though the companies in your category are already there: Clay in 92 articles across 56 publications, Apollo in 102 across 88, Warmly in 4.

The missing family is a publication object: publication identity, the article an account appeared in, the sponsors running beside it, and whether that list is rising, extracted by AI from the issue text.

Every record keeps your shape, so the fields are company, domain, publication, article URL, date and sponsor. It arrives over REST and MCP, which means it feeds the same stream the other eight feed.

If source expansion is on the roadmap, I can send a sample mapped to the field names the eight already use.
